doc.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Carter's original music and the film As Thousands Cheer
summary: The band played some Carter originals and appeared in a movie on the West Coast.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Were you playing much original music of Benny Carter’s in addition to the dance music of the time?

Some of Benny’s original music, yes. I wish I could think of some of the names. He wrote some beautiful original compositions, and I can't recall what they were at the moment. I think we’ll have to research that.
We did a lot of them the summer before last. We must have ten or twelve things that we had transcribed [for the Smithsonian Jazz Masterworks Orchestra], so if you'd like, I can give you [those].
You were in the movies, too, with that band.
Benny’s band was in one movie. What was the name of that movie?
Was that the first time you had been out to the West Coast?
